description: Oilcan 1, Polyperc 1 and Doubledecker play on channels 1, 2 and 3 for four bars at 90 BPM; a bar lasts about 2.7 seconds. Drums at velocity 38 hit steps 1/36, 4/38, 5/37, 9/36, 12/38 and 13/37 of every bar. The bass at velocity 42 plays MIDI 48 on steps 1, 5 and 13 and MIDI 55 on step 9. The chords (velocity 26, three steps long, Chd1 3rd, Chd2 5th) have roots MIDI 60 on step 1 and 62 on step 9 in bars 1 to 3, and MIDI 67 on step 49 and 60 on step 57 in bar 4. Listen for the chord changing at the start of bar 4, about 8 seconds in, over drums and bass that stay exactly the same. The drums are the loudest layer and the bass is the quietest. Build it with the three Four-Bar Percussion, Bass and Chord recipes.

title: Rhythm, bass and a changing chord
